name: admanager
description: Active Directory Onboarding Manager — Bauer Media Audio Portugal

scripts.build:manager: cross-env APP_FLAVOR=manager npm run build:renderer && cross-env APP_FLAVOR=manager electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.build:agent: cross-env APP_FLAVOR=agent npm run build:renderer && cross-env APP_FLAVOR=agent electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win portable --publish never
scripts.build:all: npm run build:manager && npm run build:agent
scripts.build:portable: cross-env APP_FLAVOR=manager npm run build:renderer && cross-env APP_FLAVOR=manager electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win portable --publish never
scripts.release:manager: cross-env APP_FLAVOR=manager npm run build:renderer && cross-env APP_FLAVOR=manager electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish always
scripts.release:agent: cross-env APP_FLAVOR=agent npm run build:renderer && cross-env APP_FLAVOR=agent electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish always
